title: Rate Addition Schedule: Closing-Years Addition to Part-Year Surrender Interest, Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
An addition to the rate of the part-year surrender interest applies on Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts surrendered in the closing years of their surrender charge schedule.

## Schedule

The closing-years addition to the part-year surrender interest rate is:

- **0.20% (0.002)** where the annuitant is aged **70** or more on the handling date and the contract is in one of its last **3** schedule years;
- **0.10% (0.001)** where the annuitant is under 70 on the handling date and the contract is in one of those last schedule years;
- nothing otherwise.

The addition is made to the rate at which the part-year surrender interest is worked, not to the interest amount. The schedule year is the one the contract is in on the handling date, counted from the surrender charge schedule start date; ages are whole years last birthday from the annuitant's date of birth.

## The last 3 schedule years of each tier

| Tier | Schedule length | Last 3 schedule years |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | 7 | 5, 6 and 7 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | 3 | 1, 2 and 3 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | 5 | 3, 4 and 5 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | 6 | 4, 5 and 6 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 7 | 5, 6 and 7 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | 10 | 8, 9 and 10 |

## Judgement cases (hypothetical, guaranteed rate 5.30%)

| Contract | Schedule year on the handling date | Annuitant's age on the handling date | Addition | Rate worked at |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 6 | 72 | 0.20% | 5.50% |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 6 | 69 | 0.10% | 5.40% |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 4 | 72 | Nothing | 5.30% |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | 8 | 70 | 0.20% | 5.50% |
